label: Colonel Ross begins on the turf (twenty years before)
quote: I have been on the turf for twenty years

label: Silver Blaze's white forehead and mottled off-foreleg are disguised
quote: You have only to wash his face and his leg in spirits of wine
note: Not said when or by whom. The horse was 'in the hands of a faker' (¶204). Brown asked Holmes 'Should I change it first or not?' (¶140).

label: Colonel Ross scratches his other horse and relies on Holmes's word
quote: We scratched our other one, and put all hopes on your word
note: After Holmes's assurance that the horse would start (¶161), and before the race.

label: The day before the race: fifteen to one against Silver Blaze
quote: You could have got fifteen to one yesterday
note: The price then shortens until the race morning.

label: Silver Blaze is sent over to the race as he is
quote: took the liberty of running him just as he was sent over
note: Holmes's account; not dated more closely than before the race.

label: Four days later: Holmes and Watson in the train bound for Winchester
quote: Four days later Holmes and I were again in the train, bound for Winchester
note: Four days after Thursday; the race was earlier said to be on Tuesday (¶18).

label: Race day: Colonel Ross meets them outside Winchester station
quote: Colonel Ross met us by appointment outside the station

label: Race day: the drive in Ross's drag to the course; talk of the horse and the betting
quote: we drove in his drag to the course beyond the town

label: Race day: the drag draws up in the enclosure; the card, the ring's odds, the numbers up
quote: As the drag drew up in the enclosure near the grand stand

label: Race day: a bay horse in Ross's colours canters out from the weighing enclosure past the drag
quote: a powerful bay horse swept out from the weighing enclosure and cantered past us

note: The start of the Wessex Cup, seen through Watson's field-glass: 'An excellent start!' (¶199).

label: Race day: the six horses come up the straight; the Mapleton yellow leads halfway
quote: half way up the yellow of the Mapleton stable showed to the front

label: Race day: Ross's horse passes the post six lengths ahead
quote: passed the post a good six lengths before its rival

label: Race day: in the weighing enclosure, Holmes shows Silver Blaze and names the horse as Straker's killer
quote: as we made our way into the weighing enclosure

label: Race day: the bell rings for the next race
